ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity-to-high intensity ratio; approximately 95% of pixels are low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white circular ring clusters located on the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe. High-intensity white pixel concentrations are localized on the extreme distal tips and along segments of the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 40-45 degrees at the vertex, separating the two primary lobe volumes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire visible trailing edge; pixel amplitude of serrations increases towards the distal tips, showing a 'saw-tooth' profile against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, slightly posteriorly-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct circular white ring patterns (rosettes) detected on the right lobe, specifically a cluster of three to four rings in the lower central area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular white scar tissue consistent with barnacle attachment sites on the right lobe surface; extensive white calcified-looking material or scarring on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white fringes on the tips of the fluke lobes that contrast sharply with the uniform dark pigmentation of the main fluke body.
